about_the_game:
Story outline

Stardate 87, the long held deadlock in the struggle between the Gilbey Allies and the Starrichnaya Empire has suddenly been broken by the invasion of Imperial Bombay.

You must become a test pilot and take the controls of the latest fighter Stinger, developed at Planet Bombay, and deliver the test aircraft to the Planet Beefeater

Game overview

This is a shooting game where you can move 360 degrees.

The acceleration of your aircraft takes inertia, so you are able to experience a unique sense of operation that you cannot experience elsewhere. Clear all the missions in order to clear the stage.

The contents of the missions are varied, such as the destruction of enemies or patroling a designated piece of airspace.

The graphic are created with a nostalgic dot picture reminiscent of an 80's arcade game.

Unique dot picture characters run around the screen.

Enemy characters have a variety of characteristics as well, some enemies dash headlong towards your aircraft, some enemies stay back and shoot guided missiles, and some take a lot of damage to defeat.

You must quickly find the right strategy appropriate for each enemy.

You can also use a gamepad that is supported by android.

By using it, more fine control is possible.
